items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Saul Broad was, as you know, the Jewish guy owned the nightclub where we played called Broad's Club Zombie.

ctx.x: What did Reuben Hughes play? Alto sax. He played alto. And this guy Saul Broad.
Saul Broad was, as you know, the Jewish guy owned the nightclub where we played called Broad's Club Zombie.
Oh, I see. I just didn't know what he did.
